    def sample(self, batch_users, sequence, positive):
        import time

        started = time.perf_counter()
        if sequence.ndim != 2 or positive.shape != sequence.shape:
            raise ValueError("Training inputs and targets must have matching B x L shapes")
        if len(batch_users) != sequence.shape[0]:
            raise ValueError("Sampled user identities must align with sequence rows")
        valid = (sequence != 0) & (positive != 0)
        rows, columns = np.nonzero(valid)
        negatives = np.zeros((rows.size, self.count), dtype=np.int64)
        keep = np.zeros(rows.size, dtype=bool)
        # Full training-history exclusions are constant across a sequence row.
        # Validate and map together while retaining independent draws per position.
        for row, user in enumerate(batch_users):
            indices = np.flatnonzero(rows == row)
            if indices.size == 0:
                continue
            blocked = self.blocked[int(user)]
            targets = positive[row, columns[indices]]
            target_indices = np.searchsorted(self.catalog, targets)
            if (target_indices >= self.catalog.size).any():
                raise RuntimeError("Training target absent from training catalog")
            if not np.array_equal(self.catalog[target_indices], targets):
                raise RuntimeError("Training target absent from training catalog")
            membership = np.searchsorted(blocked, target_indices)
            if (membership >= blocked.size).any():
                raise RuntimeError("Target missing from sampled user's training history")
            if not np.array_equal(blocked[membership], target_indices):
                raise RuntimeError("Target missing from sampled user's training history")
            observed = sequence[row, sequence[row] != 0]
            if not np.isin(observed, self.catalog[blocked]).all():
                raise RuntimeError("Input history inconsistent with sampled user identity")
            available = self.catalog.size - blocked.size
            k = min(self.count, available)
            if k == 0:
                self.skipped_positions += int(indices.size)
                continue
            ranks = np.stack([
                self.rng.choice(available, size=k, replace=False)
                for _ in range(indices.size)
            ])
            negatives[indices, :k] = self.catalog[self._map_ranks(ranks, blocked)]
            keep[indices] = True
            self.processed_positions += int(indices.size)
            self.candidate_counts[k + 1] += int(indices.size)
        self.sampling_seconds += time.perf_counter() - started
        return valid, keep, negatives[keep]
